newsitem.title: USA: Entergy sees 1997 EPS about $2.55 to $2.65.
newsitem.headline: Entergy sees 1997 EPS about $2.55 to $2.65.

text.p: Entergy Corp said Friday it expects earnings per share for 1997 in the $2.55-$2.65 range compared with $2.43 for 1996.

The company said this estimate includes about 10 million additional shares outstanding in 1997. It does not, however, include the effect of the U.K. windfall profits tax and change in U.K. corporate tax rate likely to be recorded in 1997.
In addition, the company said it expects a net income contribution for the fiscal year from its competitive growth businesses in the $0.20-0.30 per share range.
It said London Electricity should represent about half this total.
The company also said it expects U.S. utility operations will continue to see slower industrial revenue growth in the second half as two customers implement plans to self-generate.

The company reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.61 compared with $0.83 for the same period a year ago. Revenue for the period increased to $2.2 billion compared with $1.9 billion.
The company said the revenue increase is largely the result of contributions by its businesses abroad and domestic businesses not subject to state and local regulatory jurisdiction.
It also said milder than normal weather affected second quarter results. Over six months, it caused a $0.12 per share reduction in income.
